verdict.rationale: ChatGD lets attorneys query and manipulate documents via a chat interface built on OpenAI models, which is inherently a natural-language command interaction, but this tool is restricted to the firm's own attorneys rather than being an externally available feature for general AI-native users of the firm's client-facing products (Catalyze, D&O Portal, Contract Generator) which appear to be traditional form/portal based tools. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language command support in client-facing products, broader availability beyond internal attorneys, and any API/agent integration for external users.
